Glycogen is a very efﬁcient storage from of glucose, having an overall storage efﬁciency of approximately 97%.
Control of carbohydrate metabolism
Hormonal regulation
Hormones regulate (activate or inhibit) speciﬁc enzymes which catalyze the reactions of metabolic pathways (Nelson and Cox,
2017). This is achieved mainly by covalent regulation or conversion of the enzymes into their active or inactive form 7(Groff
and Gropper, 2000). Furthermore, hormones can regulate enzymes by induction or regulation of their transcription. Regulation
